title: Hunt invisible interaction details
principle: Great interaction design hides in thresholds, momentum, and metaphors. Slow-motion the everyday gestures and write down why they feel inevitable.
procedure: Pick a common gesture (swipe dismiss, rubber-band, scrub).
Record or step through it slowly; note thresholds, easing, failure cases.
Name the metaphor (physical inertia, camera depth of field, etc.).
Replicate the why in your product—not a cargo-cult animation.
Document the rule so future features stay consistent.
